map.一般不建议。XXTEA 虽修正了原始 TEA 的等价密钥问题，但仍有已知攻击（在: Generally not recommended. Although XXTEA fixes the equivalent-key issue of original TEA, known attacks remain (breakable under chosen-plaintext conditions) and the 64-bit block size brings birthday-bound problems with large data. For new projects, prioritize well-analyzed AEAD algorithms with integrity checks such as AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305.
